lines.trans: Get out of here, I told you! Leave us in peace.

words.gloss: peace, calm (оставить в покое = leave alone)

lines.trans: Vanya, this is the very best chance of your life!

words.gram: short form of Иван, used as address

lines.trans: Ever since I met you, my whole life has gone badly.
There's no job, no money! And without you I lived wonderfully.
There is your room, and here is ours. Between us is a wall, got it?
Right now everything is in your hands! You can change your family's life.
Wait, are the chances really good?
Think about it yourselves. He is the most famous man in Sineozersk!
Read the comments about him. He's a people's hero!
Everything will go well. In two months you will be the mayor's wife!
And what's in it for you?
He will become mayor and get me out. I'll tell him how.
Listen, here they write: 'Pride of Russia! Finally someone is for the people!'
And what is needed from us?
I will explain everything to you right now.
Vanya, understand at last! This is real success.
